Evelyn (CEO): Quick exec weekly — two short items: a customer billing policy update + product rollout priorities. High level: growth steady, minor Wed incident contained.
Jon (Finance): Billing policy change: starting next cycle well show Dedicated burst as a separate invoice line for transparency. Finance will share wording.
Maeve (Head of Sales): Please give AEs a 7-day lead before public notice so we can prep customers.
Evelyn (CEO): Agreed. Legal sign-off required for the wording.
legal-bot: legal: Draft billing blurb uploaded to /legal/drafts/billing-burst-195950. Review requested.
Rita (VP Eng): Product priorities: freeze large model weights changes during the Dedicated canary window. Eng will add a canary flag and auto-rollback on p99 breaches.
Sam (VP Product): Were targeting function-calling alpha to 50 accounts next Tue. Sam will coordinate comms and fallback behavior.
Evelyn (CEO): Targets this week: (1) finalize canary rollback thresholds (Rita), (2) publish billing FAQ draft (Jon + Legal) by Thu, (3) sales 1-pager on Private trials (Maeve) by Fri.
Jon (Finance): Also monitoring utilization — if Dedicated stays >72% next month finance can approve another reserved node purchase.
Maeve (Head of Sales): Noted — I'll prioritize pilot outreach.
Rita (VP Eng): RCA for Wed spike: malformed batch + KV eviction during backup window. Draft RCA to be posted Mon.
Evelyn (CEO): Thanks. Small metrics snapshot: MRR +5% MoM, Hosted latency down 3% MoM, incident count stable. Reconvene next Friday. :sparkles:
